mycelium_king: Eldritch and regal: a tall crowned sovereign of fungus, a crown of pale gills and antler-like fruiting bodies, flowing mantle of mycelium like royal robes, too many faint eyes in the dark of its face, ancient and unknowable
prismatic_colossus: A towering humanoid giant of faceted crystal, broad and monolithic, with a crown of prismatic shards and a blinding aura of refracted colour, not spider-like
the_charnel_king: An eldritch skeleton butcher: a hulking skeletal butcher in a blood-stained leather apron, wielding great cleavers and meat hooks, chains and extra mechanical arms, a crown of ribs, grisly and terrible
